Matching or beating the competitor on price would accelerate churn, not prevent it. The accounts leaving are price-sensitive by definition; discounting them deeper will only compress margins on accounts we already cannot retain. Instead, deploy activation_messaging (memory_91), which improved week-one engagement and nudged accounts to their first meaningful action. This creates product stickiness and perceived value—a defensive moat against pure price competition. It is fast to deploy, low-cost, and compounds with the onboarding simplification already in motion. A small_guarded_test scope limits downside while we measure whether messaging can shift the churn conversation from price to value realization. This preserves our ability to run the planned onboarding simplification as the primary experiment next week while buying time for leadership with a credible, low-risk intervention grounded in prior evidence. We are not yielding margin or retention discipline to competitor pressure.
